summary: Lolo NF pole L-4 lookout on Newman Peak, dated 1933 and destroyed in 1949; a 1932 item already mentions the lookout. The sources used here do not describe the site now.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Both pages date the tower to 1933, but a June 1932 Mineral Independent item already mentions the Newman Peak lookout. The sources do not explain what stood there in 1932. The story reports both dates.

notes_for_editor: Both pages give 1933 and 1949, but the weebly page attributes its entries to a source it names only as Kresek, so the two pages are not independent confirmation. The 1932 item is the only sign of an earlier structure. No access, visit or site-today information was found; the brief's gone status and L-4 design match the sources. Brief record checked: county, agency and coordinates match.
